latin: De Sensu Interno Librorum Propheticorum et Psalmorum Davidis
De Sensu Interno Librorum Propheticorum et Psalmorum Davidis

contexts.text: It has been granted me to run through all the Prophets and the Psalms of David, and to examine and see each verse as to what is there treated of; and I saw that no other things are there treated of than the Church instaurated and to be instaurated by the Lord, the Advent of the Lord, His combats, glorification, redemption, and salvation, and Heaven from Him, and at the same time their opposites.
These Summaries (quoted from the Prophets and Psalms) have been collated with the Word in Heaven, and they conform with it. AR 43:4. AR 239:6. AR 707:3. AR 859.

When I ran through the Propheticals of the Word from Isaiah to Malachi, it was granted to see that the Societies of Heaven were excited in their order, and they perceived the spiritual sense corresponding to them. DeVerbo 18. DSS 113.
